description: LLM cost from APM gen_ai spans by service.name over the last N days. Use for LLM burn, checkout-assistant, or app-level LLM FinOps.

configuration.query:
FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - ?days::integer * 1 day
  AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| EVAL cost = TO_DOUBLE(labels.llm_cost_usd)
| STATS spend_usd = SUM(cost), calls = COUNT(*)
  BY app = service.name, team = COALESCE(labels.team, "untagged")
| SORT spend_usd DESC
| LIMIT 15

days.description: Lookback window in days (7 for agent-loop questions)
